TextAndParagraphs.Heading: About Me
TextAndParagraphs.Title: From Circuits to Code.
TextAndParagraphs.TechnicalParagraph: My path into software started after a strong finish in high school, where I ranked among the top 2,500 students in Egypt. This led me to pursue a degree in Communication and Electronics Engineering, which I completed with a Very Good grade. Alongside my university coursework, I took hands-on software and web development tracks at Route Academy, building practical, production-style skills beyond the classroom. That foundation led to CyberVault, my graduation project — a secure digital banking web app where I worked on the frontend, backend API, and security implementation end-to-end.
TextAndParagraphs.PersonalParagraph: Outside of coding, I enjoy football and have been a passionate Al Ahly supporter for as long as I can remember. I also enjoy learning languages and communicate in Arabic, English, and German. As I start my career as a junior software engineer, I’m looking forward to gaining real-world experience, working with experienced developers, contributing to meaningful projects, and continuing to grow both technically and professionally.

Card.name: CyberVault
Card.description: A secure banking application that allows users to manage their finances, make transactions, and access various banking services online.

HeroSection.Title: CyberVault
HeroSection.Description: CyberVault is a full-stack banking management platform designed to handle customer accounts, financial transactions, profile management, and employee and user administration through role-specific interfaces. Built with Next.js and a dedicated Node.js/Express REST API backed by MySQL, the system combines structured business logic with authentication, role-based authorization, token security, input validation, and audit logging.

Overview.Title: Project Overview
Overview.Description: CyberVault is a full-stack banking and financial management system that combines customer banking services with internal bank administration. It supports three main roles: customers, employees, and administrators. Customers can manage their profiles, view account details and balances, and review transaction history. Employees can search for customers and manage their information according to their permissions. Administrators can manage employees and users, unlock accounts, and access administrative dashboards. Each role has its own interface and navigation. The frontend uses Next.js, React, and TypeScript, while a separate Node.js/Express backend provides a versioned REST API. Next.js API routes connect the frontend to the backend and handle request forwarding, authentication data, cookies, and responses. The backend is organized into routes, controllers, services, repositories, Sequelize models, validation, middleware, and utilities. This structure keeps responsibilities clear while supporting account management, transaction workflows, role-based administration, and layered security.

Card.name: Social Media Application
Card.description: A social media application that allows users to connect with friends, share updates, and engage with content.

HeroSection.Title: Social App
HeroSection.Description: A responsive social media web application built with React, allowing users to authenticate, explore posts, publish text and image content, interact through comments, and manage their profiles. The application integrates with an external REST API using Axios and TanStack React Query, with protected routes, schema-based form validation, reusable UI components, and responsive layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Overview.Title: Project Overview
Overview.Description: Social App is a responsive social media application where users can create accounts, sign in, browse posts, publish text and image updates, add comments, and manage their profiles. Public pages are separated from protected areas such as the feed, posts, profile, and settings. React Context manages authentication and user data, while protected routes control access for signed-in users. Axios connects the app to an external REST API, and TanStack React Query manages server data and updates. React Hook Form with Zod handles validation, while FormData supports image uploads with previews and file restrictions. Reusable components, modals, notifications, and responsive layouts keep the experience consistent. Adding friends and sharing posts are currently UI-only features.
